headline: Argentine Official Dollar Hits New High as Wholesale Rate Rises
summary: The official wholesale dollar rose to $1,545.50 with a low trading volume below $400 million, while the retail quotation at Banco Nación climbed to a new historical maximum of $1,565 for sale.
why: Exchange rate fluctuations in emerging markets directly impact domestic inflation pass-through, foreign debt servicing costs, and currency risk pricing.

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: Official exchange rate depreciation increases the peso cost per US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The official wholesale exchange rate climbed amid low trading volumes, pushing the retail quotation at Banco Nación to a record high.
